name: react-native-best-practices
headline: n-skills: AI Plugin Marketplace for Developers
short_description: n-skills is a curated marketplace for AI plugins designed to enhance the capabilities of AI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enables integration of various tools, boosting productivity and efficiency for developers and businesses alike.
author: numman-ali

sections.overview:
n-skills is a curated plugin marketplace designed to enhance AI agents including Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, and other compatible platforms. The marketplace organizes skills—such as dev-browser, zai-cli, and open-source-maintainer—that developers can integrate to expand agent functionality. Skills are defined using a universal format (SKILL.md and AGENTS.md) ensuring compatibility across multiple AI coding environments. The project maintains automated syncing of external skills from upstream repositories, keeping the marketplace current with daily updates. Developers and businesses benefit from a centralized directory that eliminates the need to hunt for compatible plugins across fragmented sources.
Integrate AI tools to enhance coding efficiency and reduce manual errors.
Streamline development workflows by automating repetitive tasks with plugins.
Utilize multi-agent orchestration to coordinate complex tasks across different AI agents.
Enhance open-source project maintenance through automated GitHub repository management.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install numman-ali/n-skills`
`git clone https://github.com/numman-ali/n-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Help me integrate the Type collaborative tool into my workflow using n-skills. I need to connect Type to my existing project management system and set up a shared workspace for my team. Provide step-by-step instructions and any necessary code snippets for seamless integration.
```
Copy

```
To integrate Type into your workflow using n-skills, follow these steps:

1. **Sign Up and Access n-skills**: Start by signing up on the n-skills marketplace. Navigate to the 'Development Tools' section and search for the Type integration plugin.

2. **Install the Plugin**: Click on the Type plugin and follow the installation instructions. This will involve granting necessary permissions and connecting your Type account to n-skills.

3. **Configure Integration Settings**: Once installed, configure the integration settings to connect Type with your existing project management system. You may need to provide API keys or other authentication details.

4. **Set Up Shared Workspace**: Create a new shared workspace in Type and invite your team members. Ensure that all necessary permissions are set correctly to allow seamless collaboration.

5. **Test the Integration**: Perform a test run to ensure that the integration is working as expected. Check if tasks and updates are being synced correctly between Type and your project management system.

By following these steps, you can effectively integrate Type into your workflow using n-skills, enhancing your team's productivity and collaboration.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
